# README for Third-Party Libraries

This project utilizes several third-party libraries to enhance functionality and streamline development. Below is a list of the key libraries used in this project, along with their purposes and links to their documentation.

## Libraries Used

1. **Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT)**
   - **Purpose**: A powerful CAD kernel that provides a wide range of tools for 3D modeling, visualization, and data exchange.
   - **Documentation**: [OCCT Documentation](https://www.opencascade.com/doc/occt/latest/)

2. **Boost**
   - **Purpose**: A collection of portable C++ source libraries that provide support for tasks and structures such as linear algebra, pseudorandom number generation, multithreading, and more.
   - **Documentation**: [Boost Documentation](https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/)

3. **Qt**
   - **Purpose**: A cross-platform application framework that is widely used for developing application software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs).
   - **Documentation**: [Qt Documentation](https://doc.qt.io/)

4. **Eigen**
   - **Purpose**: A C++ template library for linear algebra, providing high-level operations on matrices and vectors.
   - **Documentation**: [Eigen Documentation](https://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/)

## Installation

To install the required third-party libraries, please follow the instructions provided in their respective documentation. Ensure that the libraries are correctly linked in the CMake configuration.

## Usage

Refer to the main project README for instructions on how to build and run the application. This project integrates the above libraries to provide a comprehensive CAD solution.

## License

Please check the individual licenses of the third-party libraries for compliance and usage terms.
